review_notes: I read the whole 51-line file. It introduces only two declarations: `multipointConstant`, a problem-specific real constant (3^m times exp of a discount budget), and its positivity lemma. It also adds the main theorem `RegularSLEPresentation.physical_multipoint_main`, which is a theorem rather than a concept. None of these is a competing version of an existing Mathlib, Batteries or core concept. The constant is specific to this development, and the theorem uses Mathlib notions directly (`Measure.comap`, `Set.InjOn`, `DifferentiableOn`, `deriv`, `ENNReal.ofReal`, `Finset.univ`). The names `upperHalfPlane`, `survivingDomain` and `physicalConformalRadius` are defined outside this file, so I did not judge them under the rubric for this target. I did not search for further uses, so I cannot rule out a duplicate elsewhere in the project.
